activity.notes: Paoli led the Corsican Republic from 1755 to 1769 under the title General of the Corsican People. This is modeled as republican government rather than rule over France.

sources.title: Pasquale Paoli, General and Head of the Corsican Republic — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Paoli as General and Head of the Corsican Republic and gives 1755-1769 as his period of rule.
